summary: Fresh direct review of the seven corrected R201A sources and their reachable dependencies found no remaining concrete deployment-blocking source defect. Both evidenced initial blockers are corrected: loaded state equality now compares CPU tensors, and the native gate preserves RGBNT201 B64/P8/K8. The original-anchor freezing comparison, native/smoke gates, full-official additional50 protocol, fixed-best all49 GT evaluation, M8 final-neural lane boundaries and owned raw98 archive path match the stated plan. This is source acceptance only; no new neural computation, deployment or metric result was produced by this review.

checks.result: Both controls load the same full-official RGBNT201 original DeMo50 bestE28 lineage with manifest/classes/cameras/key/shape/dtype checks. Seeded new shared/fused modules are equalized by the native gate, which compares all initial state tensors and compares raw private5120 coordinates with the strict-loaded original model on eight queries. These are required runtime checks, not executed results.

Only BACKBONE, three reducers and generalFusion are frozen and recursively held in eval mode in the fixed arm. Its state check covers parameters and buffers. The new shared_projection and shared/fused heads, plus original classification heads, remain trainable. Both arms keep the same .75/.25 metric and existing objectives; intentionally different trainable counts are disclosed.

Native verification requires one real update per control, no AMP skip, every active parameter receiving finite nonzero gradient, own-Adam replay, fixed private outputs for all seven availability sets unchanged, frozen weights/buffers/modes unchanged and in-memory strict reload. Then each arm must complete exactly three smoke attempts/updates, active gradients and strict reload, without weight files. Formal mode is gated on native2/smoke6 success.

Uses all3951 train/836 query/836 gallery records with no artificial holdout, seed42/B64/P8/K8, matched retained-modality sampling and unchanged full/partial losses. Each receives an additional50 with a fresh Adam/scheduler/GradScaler512 after the same prior50 anchor. Completion requires2647 successful updates, zero skips, complete train-record coverage and exact pairwise batch-name/partial-set sequence equality.

Highest full official benchmark mAP selects a single best, preserving earliest ties and explicitly disclosing benchmark selection. Each frozen evaluator strictly loads that best, builds all seven whole-split descriptor banks and computes49 pairs with original GT exclusion. The full-input bank/distances must equal saved best arrays. CPU auditing independently reads installed GT filenames and verifies six metrics, CMC1..50, all836 query rows, camera/scene/identity groups,50-epoch selection and coverage. Two arms give98 cases; no added expert-state claim.

GPU2 preflight and formal fixed training wait for M8axis final diagnosis exit0, absent child PID and COMPLETE result. GPU3 adaptive training independently waits for the M8twins final diagnosis with the same gates. The actual M8 schedule has no later neural child on those lanes. Temporary memory gaps cannot satisfy the earlier lane gate; remaining unrelated raw archive work is not a global barrier. Runtime polling is240 seconds and checks no power/temperature.

The wrapper changes inherited callbacks and lineage metadata only inside its own process. Deployment copies only the five new runtime source files, preserving existing M8 source files, processes and stream receiver.

Each completed49 bank is GT audited before archiving. The R201A receiver copies only paths relative to its own new run root, refuses existing destinations and validates local size/SHA before acknowledgement. The server validates its owned folder boundary and each size/SHA before unlinking the49 raw NPZ files. The receiver requires two cleared completed runs and98 locally verified raw files. Original/new best weights remain outside this deletion set.

The existing deployment gate requires PASS, no blockers and exact equality with the seven plan source hashes, checks the reviewed parent bytes remotely, then copies/rechecks only the five runtime sources. Formal deployment additionally requires actual native2/smoke6 success and exit0. This SOURCE_ONLY review permits the next actual preflight step; it does not substitute for that evidence.
